name: Shinobi Kokoro
source: The protagonist, Takumi Maeda, is in his second year at Shiranuiouka School. It seemed like it was just a normal school, but it turns out that part of it is a ninja training school!
translation: The protagonist, Takumi Maeda, is in his second year at Shiranuiouka School. It seemed like it was just a normal school, but it turns out that part of it is a ninja training school!
